messages.subject: For Terrence Curtin | Industrial technology, AI infrastructure and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear TE Connectivity Media Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Terrence Curtin, Chief Executive Officer.

TE Connectivity's global portfolio across energy networks, transportation, automation and AI data-center infrastructure operates across complex government, customer and sustainability environments. That interface closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder execution might support TE Connectivity's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to TE Connectivity.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
